note:
This table represents the Garda Divisional structure under the new Garda Operating Model which was fully implemented by May 2025 and replaces [url=table/CJQ06]CJQ06.[/url]
Data may be subject to revision. Based on data extracted 01 June 2026.
From 07/11/2025 data for '[b]0412_13 Driving/In Charge of a Vehicle while Intoxicated – Alcohol and/or Drugs'[/b] - replaces [b]'0412 Driving/In Charge of a Vehicle While Over Legal Alcohol Limit'[/b] and [b]'0413 Driving/In Charge of a Vehicle Under the Influence of Drugs'[/b] from Q1 2025 onwards. These categories cannot currently be published separately due to a change in how An Garda Síochána record these crime incidents.
.. Fraud, Deception & Related offences (09) from Q3 2023 onwards reflects only those incidents reported directly to the Gardaí by members of the public. This is due to the effect of the backlog in processing suspected fraud crime incidents reported to the Gardaí by Financial Institutions under Section 19 of the Criminal Justice Act, 2011. Therefore fraud crime incident figures for pre and post Q3 2023 are not comparable. Please see [url=https://www.cso.ie/en/releasesandpublications/in/rc/march2025informationnoteonfraudcrimestatistics/]information note[/url] for further details. For revised figures from Q3 2023 onwards, please see PxStat table [url=table/CJQ11]CJQ11[/url].
